{L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} → Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L → Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L → Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L → Prop := fun {L} pre patch post => Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.ValidFrom pre patch ∧ Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.run pre patch = post

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} {pre middle post : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L} {left right : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L}, Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.Executes pre left middle → Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.Executes middle right post → Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.Executes pre (left ++ right) post

{L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} → Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L → Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L → Prop := fun {L} x x_1 => List.brecOn (motive := fun x => Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L → Prop) x_1 Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.ValidFrom._f x
∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} (left right : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L), (left ++ right).accessFootprint = left.accessFootprint ∪ right.accessFootprint

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} (store : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L) (patch : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L) (address : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Address L) (value : L.Value address.fst), Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.ValidFrom store patch → L.discipline address.fst = Minidregg.Theory.Store.Discipline.appendOnly → store address = Option.some value → (Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.run store patch) address = Option.some value

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} (store : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L) (patch : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L) (address : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Address L), (Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.run store patch) address ≠ store address → address ∈ patch.writeFootprint
{L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} → (store : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L) → (patch : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L) → Decidable (Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.ValidFrom store patch)

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} (store : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L) (patch : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L), Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.firstDisabled? store patch = Option.none ↔ Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.ValidFrom store patch

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} (store : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L) (patch : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L) (index : ℕ), Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.firstDisabled? store patch = Option.some index → Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.ValidFrom store (List.take index patch) ∧ ∃ op, patch[index]? = Option.some op ∧ ¬Minidregg.Theory.Store.Op.Enabled (Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.run store (List.take index patch)) op

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} (patch : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L) (address : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Address L), address ∈ patch.allocationFootprint ↔ ∃ op ∈ patch, op.allocationAddress? = Option.some address

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} (patch : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L) (address : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Address L), address ∈ patch.writeFootprint ↔ ∃ op ∈ patch, op.writeAddress? = Option.some address

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} (store : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L) (patch : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L) (address : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Address L), Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.ValidFrom store patch → L.discipline address.fst = Minidregg.Theory.Store.Discipline.rom → (Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.run store patch) address = store address
{L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} → Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L → Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L → Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} (store : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L) (left right : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L), Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.run store (left ++ right) = Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.run (Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.run store left) right

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} (store : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L) (op : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Op L) (rest : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L), Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.run store (op :: rest) = Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.run (Minidregg.Theory.Store.Op.apply store op) rest

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} (store : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L) (patch : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L), ∀ address ∉ patch.writeFootprint, (Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.run store patch) address = store address
∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} (store : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L), Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.run store [] = store

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} (store : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L) (left right : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L), Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.ValidFrom store (left ++ right) ↔ Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.ValidFrom store left ∧ Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.ValidFrom (Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.run store left) right
∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} (left right : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch L), (left ++ right).writeFootprint = left.writeFootprint ∪ right.writeFootprint
{L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} → Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L → Minidregg.Theory.Store.Address L → Prop := fun {L} store address => store address = Option.none
{L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} → Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L → (address : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Address L) → Option (L.Value address.fst) → Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} (store : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L) (address : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Address L) (value : Option (L.Value address.fst)), (store.set address value) address = value

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} (store : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store L) (address : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Address L) (value : Option (L.Value address.fst)) (other : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Address L), other ≠ address → (store.set address value) other = store other
